session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 9 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 9

headline.zh: 原油重回 100 美元上方、利率上行压制风险资产；苹果折叠产品成为新的需求验证点。
headline.en: Oil above $100 and higher yields pressure risk assets; Apple's foldable launch creates a new demand-validation point.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 10 日早晨，美国与香港最近完整交易日均为 9 月 9 日。标普 500 下跌 0.5% 至 7,636.36，纳指下跌 0.6% 至 26,253.34；恒指下跌 42 点至 25,274。AP 报道布伦特原油上涨 3.4%、重回每桶 100 美元上方，10 年期美债收益率升至 4.84%。基本面方面，Apple 发布首款折叠 iPhone Duo，并给出 10 月预订与发售时间；这确认产品与 AI 功能路径，但不构成销量或利润率证据。存储现货方面，TrendForce 报告 DDR4 1Gx8 3200 现货均价周环比上升 1.78%，而 DDR5 采购量有限、NAND 现货仍偏弱，显示需求并非同质化。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 10 in Shanghai, September 9 was the latest completed session in both the US and Hong Kong. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% to 7,636.36 and the Nasdaq 0.6% to 26,253.34; the Hang Seng lost 42 points to 25,274. AP reported Brent rose 3.4% back above $100 per barrel and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.84%. Fundamentally, Apple introduced its first foldable iPhone, iPhone Duo, with October preorder and availability dates; that confirms a product and AI-feature path, not sales or margin evidence. In memory spot markets, TrendForce reported a 1.78% week-over-week rise in mainstream DDR4 1Gx8 3200, while DDR5 volumes remained limited and NAND spot demand weak—evidence that demand is not homogeneous.

title.zh: 宏观风险升温；产品与基础设施证据仍需落到订单与现金回报。
title.en: Macro risk is rising; product and infrastructure evidence still needs orders and cash returns.

detail.zh: 连续两日的油价与收益率上行提高了高估值资产的折现率敏感性。Apple 的产品发布与存储的细分价格变化提供了新的跟踪点，但尚不足以抵消宏观风险或改变长期盈利判断。
detail.en: Two consecutive sessions of rising oil and yields increase discount-rate sensitivity for premium assets. Apple's product launch and segmented memory pricing add checkpoints, but do not yet offset macro risk or change a long-term earnings conclusion.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 9

title.zh: 油价与美债收益率进一步收紧估值环境
title.en: Oil and Treasury yields tighten the valuation backdrop

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油上涨 3.4%并重回每桶 100 美元上方；10 年期美债收益率从前一日的 4.80% 升至 4.84%。将此解读为高估值资产的短期折现率压力是分析判断，不是利率路径预测。
detail.en: AP reported Brent rose 3.4% back above $100 per barrel, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.84% from 4.80% the prior day. Treating this as near-term discount-rate pressure on premium assets is analysis, not a rate-path forecast.

title.zh: 香港科技指数继续跑输
title.en: Hong Kong technology continues to lag

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指 9 月 9 日收于 25,274，恒生科技指数下跌 0.76% 至 4,420。指数层面的单日表现不构成腾讯或泡泡玛特长期逻辑变化。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng closed at 25,274 on September 9 and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.76% to 4,420. An index-level one-day move does not change the long-term Tencent or Pop Mart theses.

title.zh: Apple 发布首款折叠 iPhone 与 AI 功能路径
title.en: Apple launches its first foldable iPhone and AI-feature path

detail.zh: Apple 宣布 iPhone Duo，称其为首款折叠 iPhone，搭载 A20 Pro、Apple Intelligence 与处于 beta 推出的 Siri AI；10 月 16 日开始预订，10 月 23 日发售。产品已确认，出货、组合与毛利率影响仍需销售数据验证。
detail.en: Apple announced iPhone Duo as its first foldable iPhone, with A20 Pro, Apple Intelligence and beta Siri AI; preorders begin October 16 and availability begins October 23. The product is confirmed, while shipment, mix and margin effects require sales data.

title.zh: 存储现货价格出现结构性分化
title.en: Memory spot pricing shows structural divergence

detail.zh: TrendForce 报告主流 DDR4 1Gx8 3200 现货均价从 9 月 2 日的 44.57 美元升至 9 月 8 日的 45.36 美元；DDR5 采购量仍有限，512Gb TLC 晶圆现货价周内下跌 2.71%。这说明不能用单一价格点概括整个存储周期。
detail.en: TrendForce reported mainstream DDR4 1Gx8 3200 spot pricing rose from $44.57 on September 2 to $45.36 on September 8, while DDR5 procurement remained limited and 512Gb TLC wafer spot pricing fell 2.71% during the week. One price point cannot describe the full memory cycle.
